Starting with our Organic Vermicompost, we are committed to spreading awareness about organic farming and encouraging a healthier relationship between soil, plants and nature.

SIMPLE STEPS FOR HEALTHIER PLANTS

How to Use Vermicompost?

01

Prepare the Soil

Loosen the soil and remove weeds, if any.

02

Add Vermicompost

Mix 20–30% vermicompost with garden soil.

03

Mix Gently

Blend well for even distribution of nutrients.

04

Water the Plant

Give water after application and keep soil moist.
